question: What is the URA Help Tool (Touchpoint) and how can taxpayers access customer assistance?
answer: The URA Help Tool at https://ura.go.ug/en/help-tool/ embeds the official URA Touchpoint self-service and issue-logging platform (touchpoint.ura.go.ug). It enables taxpayers to log support tickets, track complaint status, request callbacks, and resolve technical issues regarding TIN registration, EFRIS e-invoicing, DTS digital tax stamps, PRN payments, and portal navigation.

question: What are the official URA customer contact channels and toll-free helpline numbers?
answer: Taxpayers can contact URA via: 1) Toll-Free Call Centre lines: 0800 117 000 and 0800 217 000; 2) WhatsApp Support: +256 772 140 000 (0772 140 000); 3) Email: services@ura.go.ug; 4) Tax Evasion Reporting Hotline: +256 (0)323442055; 5) Online Help Tool: https://ura.go.ug/en/help-tool/; 6) Physical Headquarters: Plot M193/M194, Nakawa Industrial Area, P.O. Box 7279, Kampala; 7) Ask URA mobile app on Google Play Store.

question: How do I book an in-person appointment with a URA tax officer?
answer: To book an appointment: 1) Visit https://ura.go.ug/en/book-an-appointment/ or use the Touchpoint help tool at https://ura.go.ug/en/help-tool/; 2) Select your service category (Domestic Taxes, Customs, Motor Vehicle Registration, EFRIS Support, or Debt Settlement); 3) Choose your preferred URA regional service centre or station; 4) Select an available date and time slot; 5) Enter your 10-digit TIN, full name, phone number, and brief description of the inquiry; 6) Confirm booking to receive an appointment confirmation ticket via SMS and email to present upon arrival.

question: How does the URA Touchpoint ticketing system resolve portal technical issues?
answer: When an issue cannot be resolved through immediate self-service, taxpayers log a case on Touchpoint providing their TIN, contact information, error message screenshot, and affected PRN or assessment number. The system generates a unique support case tracking number, routes the ticket to the relevant specialized division (e.g. IT, EFRIS Support, Customs Desk, or Compliance), and provides status tracking until resolution.
